main.description: Revoke a previously-issued consent capability. Sets revokedAt/revokedBy/revocationReason on the record. Auditor webhook (when configured) receives a revocation event. Note: revocation is observable but cannot un-distribute already-fetched ciphertext; the assumption is that the grantee cooperates (and is bound by purpose-specific contractual / legal terms — e.g. iryo billing actor's clinician agreement).
